reference_method: Manually marked full-frame source rasters followed by an overlay reread. One scene per credited acquisition group. No model inference or predictions informed these references.
taxonomy: Visible assembled physical syringes, including identifiable partial bodies and attached visible components. Detached parts, reflections, packaging, insulin pens and other lookalikes are excluded.
